title: I'm building a survivors × tower defense roguelite with Opus 5.5 and Godot
author: clayman902
selftext:
You can play my alpha version right now at:  
[https://hollowlightgame.com/](https://hollowlightgame.com/)

  
This is a concept I've had in my head for some time, I always imagined these genres could play well together and I think there's something here in the idea - I think its actually kind of fun.

  
I never had the dev or art chops to actually make it. Nearly fully done in Claude - Opus 5-5 with the exception of the cut scenes and end of day screen which I used GPT for the images - I do want to replace those. Opus has struggled with my cut scene screens - they were really bad so I moved over to chatGPT for those and had it make the images - now I think they don't match the game quite right so i want to work on that more.

All the music I made myself in Reason 14 - that's been a hobby of mine for a long time so I had a large bag of partial music tracks to pull from - I put in a sort of jukebox system that shuffles a large pile of tracks and shows the user what is playing..   
  
Getting this game balanced is challenging, I have user playthrough data and events logging into a database (when share data is allowed) where telemetry can be analyzed and numbers / mechanics tweaked - this is working so far- I can have Opus review the logs of recent games and look for things to tune with the numbers. 

Its still not balanced how I want it but its made good strides on only a handful of playthroughs of data.  I hope to get more data in the system so I can see how everything is interacting better, where people struggle, or don't struggle. and get it tuned better. Give it a try if you have time - the browser will remember your last day played so it can be done in chunks and your play time helps me get this thing straight. 

I also had Opus 5.5 make the marketing trailer attached to this video.
